column1: # Historical intent ids: numbered intent files in lifecycle shelves only.
# The directory is future, planned, in-progress, complete, cancelled, archive, open, deferred, or active, including under arch-era/.
# The filename matches ^[0-9]{3}-. decisions, incidents, philosophy, and experiments are not intents.
# 000 and 999 are reserved and are not listed.
# One id, a tab, then the filename slug. A line starting with # is a comment.
# Non-ASCII marks in old filenames were replaced with ASCII.
